substitution_rules.note: Salty and savoury; no fish. Tamari contains soy.
Same heat; made where no tree nuts are handled.
Moist quick breads and muffins only; the crumb is denser.
Use a little less; adds a faint coconut taste.
Nut-free crunch in baking and on top.
For quick breads, pancakes and roux; not for yeast dough.
Lighter and tangier; stir in off the heat.

recipes.title: Sweet potato green curry
steps: Fry the paste in a splash of the coconut milk for two minutes.
Add the rest of the coconut milk and the diced sweet potato; simmer for 12 minutes.
Add the green beans and simmer for 5 minutes more.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice; top with basil and toasted cashews if using.

recipes.title: Black bean tacos with lime
steps: Soften the chopped onion in a pan.
Add the drained beans and cumin and mash lightly.
Warm the tortillas and fill them.
Finish with cilantro, lime and sour cream if using.

recipes.title: Banana bread
steps: Mash the bananas and beat in the melted butter, sugar and eggs.
Fold in the flour and baking soda, then the walnuts if using.
Bake in a lined loaf tin at 175 °C for about an hour.

recipes.title: Mushroom risotto
steps: Brown the mushrooms in half the butter and set aside.
Soften the onion, stir in the rice, then the wine if using.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 18 minutes.
Stir in the mushrooms, the rest of the butter and the parmesan.

recipes.title: Berry yogurt parfait
steps: Layer the yogurt, oats and berries in two glasses.
Drizzle with honey if using.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
steps: Soften the onion and sliced pepper with the cumin.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Make six hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until the whites set.
Crumble over the feta if using.

recipes.title: Lemon chicken traybake
steps: Toss the chicken, cut potatoes, garlic and rosemary with the oil.
Squeeze over the lemon and add the halves to the tray.
Roast at 200 °C for 40 minutes, turning once.

recipes.title: Red lentil soup
steps: Soften the onion with the cumin.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, stock and bay leaves; simmer for 25 minutes.
Take out the bay leaves, blend half and add the lemon juice.

recipes.title: Tofu fried rice
steps: Cook the rice the day before and chill it.
Fry the cubed tofu until golden, then the beans.
Push to one side, scramble the eggs, add the rice and tamari and toss until hot.
